Harbour Ferries

The 7:40 leaves from pier two until March

Harbour Ferries runs the crossing between the old town and Kettle Island. Boats leave from pier two while the north pier is rebuilt, which the council expects to finish in March.

Buying a ticket

At the kiosk

Cards only, until the last boat.

Cash to the crew, exact fare please.

Sunday boats run on the winter timetable all year.

Fares

A single is £3.20 and a return is £5.80. Bicycles travel free outside the 7:40 and 17:15 sailings, when the deck is full of commuters.

Season tickets are sold at the kiosk on pier two, which takes cards but not cash.

Getting aboard

  • The ramp at pier two is 1:12 at high tide and steeper at low water.
  • Crew will help with prams and wheelchairs; ask at the kiosk.
  • Dogs ride on deck, on a lead.

Timetables change with the tide tables each April and October.
